audience: maintenance managers and facility teams who run work orders and assets in UpKeep

useCases.title: Find overdue and high-priority work orders
useCases.text: The AI lists work orders filtered by status, priority, location, asset or assignee, with due date and cost. It points out what is late and who has it.

useCases.title: Find low-stock parts and review purchase orders
useCases.text: The AI lists parts with quantity on hand and minimum quantity and picks out those to reorder. It can also read purchase orders and their status.

useCases.title: Review an asset, its meters and readings
useCases.text: The AI opens an asset with warranty and open work orders, lists its meters and the readings of one meter, newest first.

useCases.title: Check preventive maintenance templates and requests
useCases.text: The AI lists preventive maintenance templates with their schedules and the work requests from staff with their status.

useCases.title: Create work orders or submit and approve requests
useCases.text: The AI creates a work order for an asset, location and assignee, or approves a pending request so it becomes a work order. It can also submit a new request.

useCases.title: Update a work order, a part or a meter
useCases.text: The AI changes a work order's status, priority, due date or assignee, posts a message on it, sets a part's quantity, or adds a meter reading.
